chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluyah (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Muhammad al-Ansari, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

A man complained to him about the mischief of the jinn of the earth upon his family and dependents, so he said: 'How tall is the ceiling of your house?' He answered: 'Ten cubits.' He said: 'Measure eight cubits as you go around, and inscribe upon it the Verse of the Throne, for every house whose height is more than eight cubits is occupied; the jinn will occupy it and dwell in it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended maximum height for a house ceiling in Shia tradition to keep jinn away?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), linking architectural modesty to spiritual protection against jinn habitation. The specific limit of eight cubits (zar') reflects the Prophetic tradition of avoiding ostentation, while the recitation of Ayat al-Kursi serves as a divine seal to maintain the home's sanctity. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on integrating physical domestic spaces with spiritual guardianship.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 8-9 Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluyih - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar quoted Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran al-Ash’ari, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Isa, on the authority of Abi Muhammad al-Ansari, on the authority of Aban ibn Uthman,

“A man complained to Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) and said, ‘The genies bother my family.’ The Imam (MGB) asked him, ‘How tall is the ceiling of your house?’ He answered, ‘It is ten Zar’as.’ The Imam (MGB) said, ‘You should not build a house with a ceiling higher than eight Zar’as. You should have the verse of the Throne (Ayat al-Kursi) inscribed as a decoration around it. Any room that is taller than eight Zar’as would be occupied by genies.’”
